title: Neural Correlates of a Visuospatial Intervention Following Memory Reactivation in Patients with Trauma-Related Disorders—A Resting-State fMRI Study
summary: Das Projekt findet als nicht-experimentelle fMRT-Studie mit Intervention statt. An einer Gruppe (N=40) von Patienten, die über häufige Intrusionen nach mindestens einer traumatischen Erfahrung berichten, wird die neuronale Hirnaktivität in sogenannten Ruhenetzwerken mittels fMRT vor und nach der Anwendung des Computerspiels Tetris im Vergleich zu einer aktiven Kontrollgruppe untersucht.

interventions.name: Visuospatial intervention: Writing down the content (reactivation) of a recurring trauma-related intrusion, followed by playing the computer game Tetris for 25 minutes (visuospatial condition).
Active control condition: Reading a Wikipedia article (“Postage Stamp”) and answering multiple-choice questions about the text (cognitive, non-visuospatial condition).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- A criterion for posttraumatic stress disorder according to DSM-5
- Experience recurrent intrusions (at least 5 intrusions per week) related to a single traumatic event that occurred at least 2 months ago
- Fluent in German
- Right-handed
- (Partial) inpatient or outpatient therapy at the Clinic for Psychosomatic Medicine and
Psychotherapy at Fulda Hospital
- Willingness and motivation to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
-Current substance abuse (excluding nicotine) or a history of such abuse within the past 6 months
-Severe self-injurious behavior (defined as self-inflicted injuries requiring medical care) within the past 6 months
-Psychotic symptoms within the last 6 months
-Acute suicidal ideation
-Contraindications for an MRI scan (e.g., pregnancy, ferromagnetic implants, claustrophobia), which will be ascertained separately
